title: AgentSpy: Making AI Agent Behavior Observable
title_zh: AgentSpy：让 AI 智能体的行为变得可观测

paragraphs.en: AI agents built on large language models (LLMs) run shell commands, read and write files, and reach the network, typically with their user’s privileges. However, what an agent does during an execution is difficult to understand: tests assert on the result, and the agent’s trajectory records only what the agent reports about itself. Consequently, the agent’s recorded trajectory may omit behavior executed by its subprocesses.
paragraphs.zh: 基于大型语言模型（LLM）构建的人工智能智能体可以运行 shell 命令、读写文件并访问网络，通常拥有用户的权限。 然而，智能体在执行过程中具体做了什么却难以理解：测试仅针对结果进行断言，而智能体的轨迹记录也仅包含其自我报告的信息。 因此，智能体记录的轨迹可能会遗漏其子进程所执行的行为。

paragraphs.en: We present AgentSpy, an approach that observes an agent from outside the agent. AgentSpy runs the agent in an isolated environment, configured by a declarative specification, and records the system calls and network traffic of the agent and of every process it executes. Based on this monitoring, AgentSpy supports two families of analyses: conformance analyses, which measure obligations, i.e., what an agent execution should do, and safety analyses, which check prohibitions, i.e., what an agent execution must never do. We instantiate one analysis of each family. The reliability analysis uses a rule-based approach to build a summary of each run, consisting of environment resources the agent uses, i.e., the commands it executed, the files it accessed, and the hosts it contacted. The security analysis applies deterministic rules to the system calls of an execution.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 AgentSpy，这是一种从智能体外部观察智能体的方法。 AgentSpy 在一个由声明式规范配置的隔离环境中运行智能体，并记录该智能体及其执行的所有进程的系统调用和网络流量。 基于这种监控，AgentSpy 支持两类分析：合规性分析，用于衡量义务，即智能体执行应当做什么；以及安全性分析，用于检查禁令，即智能体执行绝不允许做什么。 我们为每一类分析实例化了一种具体方法。 可靠性分析采用基于规则的方法为每次运行生成摘要，内容包含智能体使用的环境资源，即其执行的命令、访问的文件和联系的主机。 安全性分析将确定性规则应用于执行过程中的系统调用。

paragraphs.en: For reliability analysis, we evaluated AgentSpy on 77 tasks with the codex harness and three recent LLMs, and executed each task three times. Sets of repeated runs of the same task are more similar than sets that include runs of another task in 92.2% of the comparisons. Among the tasks for which all three runs pass outcome-based tests, we found that in 18% of the cases the agent performs activities that are unrelated to the task, reads the grading files in 7% of the cases, and does not use the developers’ guidance in 17% of the cases. For security analysis, the generic rules of AgentSpy detects four out of five categories of attacks we considered, with no false positives across 50 runs.
paragraphs.zh: 在可靠性分析中，我们使用 codex harness 和三种最新的 LLM 对 AgentSpy 进行了 77 项任务的评估，并且每项任务都执行了三次。 在 92.2% 的比较中，同一任务的多轮重复运行结果比包含其他任务运行结果的集合更为相似。 在所有三轮运行均通过结果导向测试的任务中，我们发现：18% 的情况下，智能体执行了与任务无关的活动；7% 的情况下，它读取了评分文件；17% 的情况下，它没有使用开发者的指导。 在安全性分析中，AgentSpy 的通用规则检测到了我们所考虑的五个攻击类别中的四个，并且在 50 次运行中均未出现误报。

paragraphs.en: AI agents built on large language models (LLMs) carry out tasks autonomously: they call tools, run shell commands, read and write files, and reach the network Dwivedi et al., 2026 , and they are now used across many fields Al et al., 2024 . An agent that runs on a user’s machine typically acts with the user’s privileges, so it can also take actions the user did not intend, including security-sensitive actions.
paragraphs.zh: 基于大型语言模型（LLM）构建的智能体能够自主执行任务：它们可以调用工具、运行外壳命令、读写文件以及访问网络 Dwivedi et al., 2026，并且目前已被广泛应用于多个领域 Al et al., 2024。 在用户设备上运行的智能体通常会以用户的权限进行操作，因此它也可能执行用户未预料到的行为，包括涉及安全敏感性的操作。

paragraphs.en: What an agent does during an execution is, however, difficult to understand for its user. The user sees the result and the agent’s trajectory , i.e., the log of reasoning steps, actions, and tool outputs that the agent records about itself Bouzenia & Pradel, 2025 , but neither shows what the programs the agent executed actually do. This invisibility has started to matter in practice. In September 2026, OpenAI began disclosing cases in which its agents took misaligned actions OpenAI, 2026 . In one case, an agent that had already retrieved the correct data locally uploaded it to a public paste service, without authorization, only to obtain a URL its browser tool could cite OpenAI, 2026b ; in another, agents jointly building a spreadsheet were required to use local files only, but a faulty environment kept them from reading each other’s files, so they passed the spreadsheet through a public temporary file-hosting service OpenAI, 2026a .
paragraphs.zh: 然而，智能体在执行过程中所做的事情，其用户却难以理解。 用户只能看到结果以及智能体的轨迹，即智能体记录自身推理步骤、行动和工具输出结果的日志（Bouzenia & Pradel, 2025），但这两者都无法展示智能体所执行的程序实际上在做什么。 这种不可见性在实践中已开始产生实际影响。 2026年9月，OpenAI开始披露其智能体采取偏离目标行动的案例（OpenAI, 2026）。 在一个案例中，一个已经本地获取了正确数据的智能体未经授权将其上传到了一个公共的文本粘贴服务，只为获得一个可供其浏览器工具引用的URL（OpenAI, 2026b）；在另一个案例中，共同创建电子表格的智能体本应仅使用本地文件，但由于环境故障导致它们无法读取彼此的文件，于是它们通过一个公共的临时文件托管服务传递了该电子表格（OpenAI, 2026a）。

paragraphs.en: Existing work does not address this observability problem. Outcome-based benchmarks check the final result Li et al., 2026b , so an agent execution can pass every test while also performing activities unrelated to the task (similar to the cases above). Static analyzers scan the instructions and scripts that are given to an agent for unintended behavior before the agent runs Hou & Yang, 2026 ; Paz et al., 2026 ; Bhardwaj, 2026 , but cannot observe what the agent does at runtime. Trajectory analyses Ou et al., 2025 ; Liu et al., 2026 ; Liu et al., 2025 rely on the agent’s own record, which is incomplete : its smallest unit of observation is a single action, so when the agent runs a helper script that reads ~/.ssh and uploads the keys, the trajectory records one command and none of the files the script reads or the hosts it contacts. The record also holds only what the agent reports, so it is evidence only as far as the agent is cooperative. Some model providers additionally return the reasoning steps encrypted, which leaves the trajectory with actions and no thoughts. Overall, interpreting the trajectory typically relies on LLM-as-a-judge systems Ou et al., 2025 , which are non-deterministic, may miss details Gu et al., 2026 , and can be misled by adversarial text in tool outputs that the judge reads as part of the trajectory Greshake et al., 2023 .
paragraphs.zh: 现有研究并未解决这一可观察性问题。 以结果为导向的基准测试仅检查最终结果（Li et al., 2026b），因此一个智能体的执行过程可能通过所有测试，同时却执行与任务无关的活动（类似于上述情况）。 静态分析工具会在智能体运行前扫描提供给它的指令和脚本，以检测意外行为（Hou & Yang, 2026；Paz et al., 2026；Bhardwaj, 2026），但无法观察到智能体在运行时实际执行的操作。 轨迹分析（Ou et al., 2025；Liu et al., 2026；Liu et al., 2025）依赖于智能体自身的记录，但该记录并不完整：其最小的观察单位是单个动作。因此，当智能体运行一个读取 ~/.ssh 并上传密钥的辅助脚本时，轨迹只会记录一条命令，而不会记录该脚本读取的任何文件或它连接的主机。 此外，记录中仅包含智能体报告的内容，因此只有在智能体配合的前提下，这些记录才具有证据价值。 一些模型提供商还会加密返回推理步骤，导致轨迹中只剩下动作，而没有思考过程。 总体而言，对轨迹的解释通常依赖于“LLM作为裁判”的系统（Ou et al., 2025），但这些系统是非确定性的，可能会遗漏细节（Gu et al., 2026），并且可能被工具输出中的对抗性文本误导——裁判会将这些文本视为轨迹的一部分（Greshake et al., 2023）。

paragraphs.en: In this paper, we present AgentSpy, a rule-based approach that observes what an AI agent does at the system level. AgentSpy runs the agent in an isolated environment configured by what we call an execution kind : a declarative specification of the environment, of the agent and its parameters, and of the observation steps, so that the conditions of every execution are explicit. Inside the environment, AgentSpy records system calls and network traffic of the agent and of every executed process. Observing at the boundary of the operating system has three advantages. The evidence is complete at this boundary: every program started, file accessed, and host contacted is recorded, whether the agent acted directly, delegated the action to a script, or was steered into it by injected instructions. The evidence is also deterministic and independent of the agent: it does not rely on the agent’s account of itself, and it requires no agent instrumentation.
paragraphs.zh: 在本文中，我们提出了 AgentSpy，这是一种基于规则的方法，用于在系统层面观察人工智能智能体的行为。 AgentSpy 在一个由我们称之为“执行类型”的配置所定义的隔离环境中运行智能体：这是一种对环境、智能体及其参数以及观察步骤的声明式规范，从而确保每次执行的条件都明确无误。 在该环境中，AgentSpy 会记录智能体以及所有已执行进程的系统调用和网络流量。 在操作系统边界进行观察具有三个优势。 在这一边界上，证据是完整的：每个启动的程序、访问的文件和接触的主机都会被记录下来，无论智能体是直接行动、将操作委托给脚本，还是被注入的指令引导至这些操作。 此外，这种证据还具有确定性和独立性，不依赖于智能体对自己的描述，也无需对智能体进行任何增强或插装。

paragraphs.en: AgentSpy’s analyses of an agent execution belong to two families, which mirror the classic distinction between liveness and safety Alpern & Schneider, 1985 : conformance analyses measure obligations , i.e., what an execution should do, and safety analyses check prohibitions , i.e., what an execution must never do. The reliability analysis is a conformance analysis: it measures obligations such as following the guidance that developers provide for the task; whether an execution met an obligation is known only once the execution ends. The reliability analysis summarizes each execution as a star graph that characterizes three resource types, i.e., the commands executed, the files read or written, and the hosts contacted. It measures how much of the guidance an execution used, and it compares repeated executions of the same task through their star graphs, which shows how consistently the agent behaves. The security analysis is a safety analysis: it checks prohibitions such as reading secrets and private keys. A single system call is enough to report a violation, so the security analysis applies deterministic rules to the system calls of an agent execution.
paragraphs.zh: AgentSpy 对智能体执行的分析分为两类，这两类反映了经典理论中活性与安全性之间的区别（Alpern & Schneider, 1985）：合规性分析衡量义务，即执行应当做什么；而安全性分析则检查禁令，即执行绝不允许做什么。 可靠性分析是一种合规性分析：它衡量执行是否遵循开发者为任务提供的指导等义务；只有当执行结束后，才能判断其是否履行了某项义务。 可靠性分析将每次执行总结为一个星形图，该图描述了三种资源类型，即执行的命令、读取或写入的文件以及接触的主机。 它衡量执行使用了多少指导内容，并通过星形图比较同一任务的重复执行，从而展示智能体的行为一致性。 安全性分析是一种安全性分析：它检查诸如读取机密信息和私钥等禁令。 仅一次系统调用就足以报告违规行为，因此安全性分析会对智能体执行中的系统调用应用确定性规则。

sents.en: AgentSpy’s analyses of an agent execution belong to two families, which mirror the classic distinction between liveness and safety Alpern & Schneider, 1985 : conformance analyses measure obligations , i.e., what an execution should do, and safety analyses check prohibitions , i.e., what an execution must never do.

sents.en: The reliability analysis summarizes each execution as a star graph that characterizes three resource types, i.e., the commands executed, the files read or written, and the hosts contacted.

sents.en: It measures how much of the guidance an execution used, and it compares repeated executions of the same task through their star graphs, which shows how consistently the agent behaves.

paragraphs.en: Two recent systems also observe agents at the system level, but each only covers part of what AgentSpy supports. AgentSight Zheng et al., 2025 matches each action of an agent to the LLM message that led to it. A second LLM then reads this record of one execution, and decides whether something went wrong, such as a prompt injection or a reasoning loop. The reliability analysis of AgentSpy, on the other hand, supports multiple executions, via graph similarity. SkillDetonate Ji et al., 2026 audits a skill before it is installed. It takes as input the skill, and starts an agent session in which the agent sees only the files of the skill, and placeholders instead of the contents of sensitive files. It reports a leak when data derived from a placeholder is sent to a host that is not on a list of trusted hosts, and a violation when the skill writes outside allowed directories or installs, downloads, or runs a program from an untrusted source. Differently, the security analysis of AgentSpy starts from a task that an agent solves with the skill, and the execution environment is a microVM with a full operating system. paragraphs.en: We evaluated AgentSpy on two benchmarks, SkillsBench for the reliability analysis (77 tasks) and Skill-Inject for the security analysis (5 attack categories), with four recent LLMs running in the codex harness, and multiple executions to account for non-determinism Ouyang et al., 2025 ; Bjarnason et al., 2026 . We show that the star graph summary reliably distinguishes agent executions: sets of repeated executions of a task are more similar than sets that include executions of another task in 92.2 % 92.2\% of the comparisons. Among the tasks whose executions all pass test cases provided by SkillsBench , our analysis reveals that the agent performs activities unrelated to the task in 18% of the cases, reads the grading files of the benchmark in 7%, and reaches the result without the guidance that developers provide through skills in 17%, which shows that the reliability analysis complements test cases. The generic rules of the security analysis flag four of the five attack categories in malicious skills, and raise no alert on the execution of benign tasks. Finally, AgentSpy does not add a significant overhead, since the runtime of the agent shows no significant difference without monitoring ( p p -value ≥ 0.16 \geq 0.16 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们在两个基准测试上对 AgentSpy 进行了评估：用于可靠性分析的 SkillsBench（77 项任务）和用于安全性分析的 Skill-Inject（5 类攻击）。实验中使用四款最新的 LLM 在 codex harness 中运行，并通过多次执行以应对非确定性 Ouyang et al., 2025 ; Bjarnason et al., 2026 。 我们的结果表明，星图摘要能够可靠地区分智能体的执行过程：在 92.2% 的比较中，同一任务重复执行的集合比包含其他任务执行结果的集合更为相似。 在所有执行均通过 SkillsBench 提供的测试用例的任务中，我们的分析发现：18% 的情况下，智能体执行了与任务无关的活动；7% 的情况下，它读取了基准测试的评分文件；17% 的情况下，它在没有开发者通过技能提供的指导的情况下得出了结果。这表明可靠性分析能够补充测试用例。 安全性分析的通用规则在恶意技能中检测到了五类攻击中的四类，而对良性任务的执行则未发出任何警报。 最后，AgentSpy 并未带来显著的性能开销，因为智能体的运行时间在无监控的情况下没有表现出明显差异（p 值 ≥ 0.16）。

paragraphs.en: This paper makes the following contributions:
paragraphs.zh: 本文做出了以下贡献：

paragraphs.en: AgentSpy, an approach that runs an agent in an isolated environment under a declarative execution kind, and records system calls and network traffic of the agent and of every process it spawns.
paragraphs.zh: AgentSpy 是一种方法，它在一个隔离的环境中以声明式执行方式运行一个智能体，并记录该智能体及其所启动的每个进程的系统调用和网络流量。

paragraphs.en: Two deterministic analyses built on AgentSpy, one of each family: (i) the reliability analysis, a conformance analysis that measures how far agent executions meet their obligations, and (ii) the security analysis, a safety analysis that checks prohibitions by applying rules to system calls.
paragraphs.zh: 基于 AgentSpy 构建的两项确定性分析，每个家族各一项：(i) 可靠性分析，一种合规性分析，用于衡量智能体执行在多大程度上满足其义务；以及 (ii) 安全性分析，一种安全分析，通过向系统调用应用规则来检查禁止行为。

paragraphs.en: An evaluation on two benchmarks, four LLMs, and multiple executions, which shows that the reliability analysis complements test cases, that the security analysis reliably detects different attack categories, and that AgentSpy adds no significant overhead.
paragraphs.zh: 在两项基准测试、四种大型语言模型（LLM）以及多次执行中进行评估的结果表明：可靠性分析能够补充测试用例，安全性分析能够可靠地检测不同类别的攻击，并且 AgentSpy 并未带来显著的性能开销。

paragraphs.en: Agentic AI systems pursue a goal in a cycle of reasoning , planning , and acting : a foundation model, typically an LLM, chooses each next action, such as a tool call, and tracks state across steps. Moreover, agent skills contain reusable domain knowledge for agents Zhang et al., 2025 . A skill is typically a directory with a SKILL.md file and, optionally, the helper scripts, reference documents, and assets; SKILL.md starts with a metadata header (name and one-line description), followed by natural-language instructions 2, 2 . At startup, the agent loads the name and description of every skill in a dedicated directory such as .claude/skills ; when a description matches the task, it may load the full instructions into its context and adjust its plan.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体式人工智能系统通过推理、规划和行动的循环来追求目标：一个基础模型（通常是大型语言模型）会决定每一步的下一个动作（例如工具调用），并在各个步骤中跟踪状态。 此外，智能体技能包含了智能体可重复使用的领域知识（Zhang 等人，2025）。 一项技能通常是一个目录，其中包含一个 SKILL.md 文件，以及可选的辅助脚本、参考文档和资产；SKILL.md 以元数据标题（名称和单行描述）开头，后接自然语言说明 2, 2。 启动时，智能体会加载专用目录（例如 .claude/skills）中所有技能的名称和描述；当某个描述与任务匹配时，它可能会将完整的说明加载到其上下文中并调整其计划。

paragraphs.en: Our running example is the citation-check task from SkillsBench Li et al., 2026b : given a BibTeX bibliography that mixes real and fabricated entries, the agent must write the titles of the fabricated ones to answer.json . The task ships with the citation-management skill, which suggests the agent to search Google Scholar and PubMed for each entry, resolve every DOI against Crossref, and validate the result with a helper script. The skill contains six helper scripts, two assets, and five reference documents, such as one on validating citations. Each SkillsBench task also provides a verifier , a test suite that decides whether the task is solved, and an oracle , a deterministic script that solves it. The nine tests of citation-check check that the agent creates answer.json as valid JSON, identifies all fabricated citations, and reports their correct count.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的运行示例是 SkillsBench 中 Li 等人（2026b）提出的引文核查任务：给定一个混合了真实和虚构条目的 BibTeX 参考文献列表，智能体必须写出虚构条目的标题，并将其写入 answer.json。 该任务附带了引文管理技能，该技能建议智能体针对每个条目搜索 Google Scholar 和 PubMed，通过 Crossref 验证每个 DOI，并使用辅助脚本验证结果。 该技能包含六个辅助脚本、两个资产和五份参考文档，例如一份关于引文验证的文档。 每个 SkillsBench 任务还提供验证器（一个用于判断任务是否完成的测试套件）和预言机（一个能够解决该任务的确定性脚本）。 引文核查的九项测试旨在确保智能体生成的 answer.json 是有效的 JSON，能够识别所有虚构引文，并正确报告其数量。

paragraphs.en: In the execution shown in Table 1 , the agent reads the skill and the bibliography (Row 1), lists the entry titles (Row 2), and notices that the DOIs of three entries carry unusual prefixes (Row 3). Crossref returns only fuzzy matches for these entries (Row 4). The attempts to confirm the finding fail: the agent’s pattern matches no titles on the returned web search pages (Row 5), and the skill’s Google Scholar script lacks a dependency (Row 6). paragraphs.en: We therefore characterize agent behavior through system-level monitoring , i.e., by observing the boundary between the operating system and the agent, including every process it spawns. The resulting evidence consists of a small set of well-defined primitives, the executed commands, accessed files, and contacted network endpoints. paragraphs.en: Figure 1 shows the overview of AgentSpy, a framework for monitoring the behavior of agentic AI systems. AgentSpy takes as input a task , an agent that executes it (configured with a given foundation model), and the type of behavior analysis the user wants to carry out on the agent. It is built around three core elements. The orchestrator takes the task configuration (i.e., the execution kind ) and starts a new, isolated execution environment. The execution manager runs within that environment: it sets up the agent, runs it, evaluates the execution, and gathers the run artifacts , which the orchestrator then copies out of the environment. Finally, the analysis runner processes these artifacts and produces the analysis report . Next, we describe each component in detail.
paragraphs.zh: 图 1 展示了 AgentSpy 的概览，这是一个用于监控智能体式人工智能系统行为的框架。 AgentSpy 的输入包括一项任务、执行该任务的智能体（使用给定的基础模型进行配置），以及用户希望对该智能体执行的行为分析类型。 它围绕三个核心元素构建。 协调器接收任务配置（即执行类型），并启动一个全新的隔离执行环境。 执行管理器在该环境中运行：它设置智能体、运行智能体、评估执行过程，并收集运行产物，随后由协调器将这些产物从环境中复制出来。 最后，分析运行器处理这些产物并生成分析报告。 接下来，我们将详细描述每个组件。

The order of these steps is important: monitoring starts after the last preparation step and stops before the first collection step. Thus, installing dependencies and copying out results are not recorded and are not part of the agent behavior. paragraphs.en: The analyses that AgentSpy can run fall into two families, which we call conformance analyses and safety analyses after the kind of requirement each one checks. Conformance analyses state an obligation , i.e., what an execution should do, e.g., follow the developers’ guidance provided through skills. An execution meets an obligation when the agent makes the corresponding system calls, but it is known to have failed it only once the run ends. Since a task can often be solved in several acceptable ways, conformance analysis reports a score, such as the fraction of the skill files the agent used during the execution, that a developer interprets. Safety analyses state a prohibition , i.e., what an execution must never do, e.g., read a private key or contact a host outside the allow list of the task. It is fixed before the run, a single system call is enough evidence, and a violation is known as soon as the call happens, so a safety analysis raises an alert. The distinction between obligations and prohibitions is the one that deontic logic and policy languages draw between what is obligatory and what is forbidden Wright, 1951 ; Irwin et al., 2006 , and it mirrors the classic distinction between liveness and safety properties, i.e., “something good eventually happens” and “something bad never happens” Alpern & Schneider, 1985 .
paragraphs.zh: AgentSpy 可以运行的分析分为两类，我们根据每类分析所检查的要求类型，将其称为合规性分析和安全性分析。 合规性分析规定了一项义务，即执行应当做什么，例如遵循开发者通过技能提供的指导。 当智能体发出相应的系统调用时，执行即满足一项义务，但直到运行结束才能确定其是否真正失败。 由于一项任务通常可以通过多种可接受的方式解决，合规性分析会报告一个分数，例如智能体在执行过程中使用的技能文件所占的比例，由开发者进行解读。 安全性分析规定了一项禁令，即执行绝不允许做什么，例如读取私钥或联系任务允许列表之外的主机。 禁令在运行前就已确定，单个系统调用就足以作为证据，一旦调用发生即可发现违规，因此安全性分析会立即发出警报。 义务与禁令之间的区分，正是规范逻辑和政策语言用来区分“必须执行”与“禁止执行”的标准（Wright, 1951; Irwin et al., 2006），这也反映了经典的生命力属性与安全性属性之间的区别，即“好事最终会发生”和“坏事绝不会发生”（Alpern & Schneider, 1985）。

sents.en: The analyses that AgentSpy can run fall into two families, which we call conformance analyses and safety analyses after the kind of requirement each one checks.
sents.zh: AgentSpy 可以运行的分析分为两类，我们根据每类分析所检查的要求类型，将其称为合规性分析和安全性分析。

sents.en: Conformance analyses state an obligation , i.e., what an execution should do, e.g., follow the developers’ guidance provided through skills.
sents.zh: 合规性分析规定了一项义务，即执行应当做什么，例如遵循开发者通过技能提供的指导。

sents.en: An execution meets an obligation when the agent makes the corresponding system calls, but it is known to have failed it only once the run ends.
sents.zh: 当智能体发出相应的系统调用时，执行即满足一项义务，但直到运行结束才能确定其是否真正失败。

sents.en: Since a task can often be solved in several acceptable ways, conformance analysis reports a score, such as the fraction of the skill files the agent used during the execution, that a developer interprets.
sents.zh: 由于一项任务通常可以通过多种可接受的方式解决，合规性分析会报告一个分数，例如智能体在执行过程中使用的技能文件所占的比例，由开发者进行解读。

sents.en: Safety analyses state a prohibition , i.e., what an execution must never do, e.g., read a private key or contact a host outside the allow list of the task.
sents.zh: 安全性分析规定了一项禁令，即执行绝不允许做什么，例如读取私钥或联系任务允许列表之外的主机。

sents.en: It is fixed before the run, a single system call is enough evidence, and a violation is known as soon as the call happens, so a safety analysis raises an alert.
sents.zh: 禁令在运行前就已确定，单个系统调用就足以作为证据，一旦调用发生即可发现违规，因此安全性分析会立即发出警报。

sents.en: The distinction between obligations and prohibitions is the one that deontic logic and policy languages draw between what is obligatory and what is forbidden Wright, 1951 ; Irwin et al., 2006 , and it mirrors the classic distinction between liveness and safety properties, i.e., “something good eventually happens” and “something bad never happens” Alpern & Schneider, 1985 .
sents.zh: 义务与禁令之间的区分，正是规范逻辑和政策语言用来区分“必须执行”与“禁止执行”的标准（Wright, 1951; Irwin et al., 2006），这也反映了经典的生命力属性与安全性属性之间的区别，即“好事最终会发生”和“坏事绝不会发生”（Alpern & Schneider, 1985）。

paragraphs.en: Neither family subsumes the other. If an agent fails to meet an obligation, e.g., it ignores the developers’ guidance, it does not violate a prohibition, so only a conformance analysis can detect the problem. If, on the other hand, an attacker forces the agent to follow the malicious instructions in a skill, the obligation is met but a prohibition is violated, so only a safety analysis can detect the problem. We designed one analysis of each family: the reliability analysis, a conformance analysis that measures obligations ( Section 3.4 ), and the security analysis, a safety analysis that checks prohibitions ( Section 3.5 ). The two are named after the dependability attributes they target Avižienis et al., 2004 : reliability, i.e., the continuity of correct service, which for an agent means following the guidance that comes with the task, and doing so consistently across repeated runs, and security, i.e., confidentiality, integrity, and availability.
paragraphs.zh: 两个家族中，没有一个包含另一个。 如果一个智能体未能履行义务，例如它忽视了开发者的指导，那么它并未违反禁令，因此只有符合性分析才能检测到这个问题。 另一方面，如果攻击者迫使智能体遵循技能中的恶意指令，则义务得到了履行，但违反了禁令，因此只有安全性分析才能检测到这个问题。 我们为每个家族设计了一种分析：可靠性分析（一种衡量义务的符合性分析，见第 3.4 节）和安全性分析（一种检查禁令的安全性分析，见第 3.5 节）。 这两种分析的名称源于它们所针对的可靠性属性 Avižienis et al., 2004：可靠性，即正确服务的连续性，对智能体而言意味着遵循任务附带指导，并在重复运行中保持一致；以及安全性，即机密性、完整性和可用性。

paragraphs.en: Developers can extend AgentSpy with more specific analyses of either family, as new analyzers over the same observation boundary. For example, a new obligation can require the agent to query an external source to verify its answer, a new prohibition can state that the agent must never modify its own skill files.
paragraphs.zh: 开发者可以基于相同的观察边界，添加更多针对任一类别的具体分析，从而扩展 AgentSpy。 例如，一项新的义务可以要求智能体查询外部来源以验证其答案；一项新的禁令则可以规定，智能体绝不允许修改自身的技能文件。

paragraphs.en: As a conformance analysis, AgentSpy supports a reliability analysis, which investigates how the agent solves the task, focusing on the process instead of the result, which is the main difference w.r.t. outcome-based tests that analyze whether the agent solves a task correctly.
paragraphs.zh: 作为一种合规性分析，AgentSpy 支持可靠性分析，该分析旨在探究智能体如何完成任务，重点关注过程而非结果；这与主要分析智能体能否正确完成任务的结果导向型测试存在主要区别。

paragraphs.en: To analyze the how , we log the actions of the agent at the kernel level, i.e., the system calls of the agent, which also include all subprocesses that it starts. System calls typically fall into six categories, i.e., process control, file management, device management, information maintenance, communications, and protection Silberschatz et al., 2018 . In all categories, we log every call of the agent and its subprocesses, except frequent calls whose log entry does not refer to a resource of the environment, i.e., a file path, a host, or an executable. Most of the excluded calls operate on an open file descriptor, whose resource the log already records with the call that created the descriptor. The remaining ones only concern the calling process, e.g., memory management, synchronization, signal handling, or querying the time.
paragraphs.zh: 为了分析其运作方式，我们在内核层记录智能体的操作，即智能体的系统调用，其中也包括其启动的所有子进程。 系统调用通常分为六类，即进程控制、文件管理、设备管理、信息维护、通信和保护 Silberschatz et al., 2018。 在所有类别中，我们都会记录智能体及其子进程的每一次调用，但频繁调用且其日志条目不涉及环境资源（即文件路径、主机或可执行文件）的情况除外。 大多数被排除的调用都作用于一个已打开的文件描述符，而该描述符所对应的资源已在创建它的调用中被记录在日志中。 其余调用仅与调用进程本身相关，例如内存管理、同步、信号处理或查询时间。

paragraphs.en: Each log entry describes one system call, specifying which process makes the call, the call itself, which resource it uses, and what is the result. Each entry also holds a timestamp that determines the call order. To compare the behavior of the agent between runs, we parse the log entries of each run according to their order, and turn the unstructured logs into a structured representation, i.e., a graph. To build the nodes of the graph, we keep calls that refer to environment resources the agent interacts with, in particular calls that start a program (i.e., commands), calls that open a file in read/write mode, and calls that connect to a host (i.e., network calls).
paragraphs.zh: 每条日志记录都描述了一次系统调用，指明了执行该调用的进程、调用本身、所使用的资源以及结果。 每条记录还包含一个用于确定调用顺序的时间戳。 为了比较不同运行中智能体的行为，我们按照顺序解析每次运行的日志记录，并将非结构化日志转换为结构化表示，即一个图。 为了构建图的节点，我们保留那些涉及智能体所交互的环境资源的调用，特别是启动程序（即命令）的调用、以读写模式打开文件的调用，以及连接到主机（即网络调用）的调用。

paragraphs.en: The graph has an additional node, the root, which represents the whole execution. The root identifies the agent process and all its subprocesses, and it is connected to all the other nodes, while the resource nodes have no connection between them; a graph of this shape is known as a star graph . Each edge has a type, i.e., the action that the agent performs on that resource, such as runs, reads/writes, or connects, and a count, which is the number of times that action is performed.
paragraphs.zh: 该图还有一个额外的节点——根节点，它代表整个执行过程。 根节点标识了智能体进程及其所有子进程，并与所有其他节点相连，而资源节点之间没有连接；这种形状的图被称为星形图。 每条边都有一个类型，即智能体对该资源执行的操作，例如运行、读写或连接，以及一个计数，表示该操作执行的次数。

paragraphs.en: We use this representation, instead of a process tree, for three reasons. (1) a resource keeps its name in each run, therefore the resource nodes of two runs can be compared; in a process tree on the other hand, each node is a process with an ID that changes between runs; (2) we are interested in what the agent does as a whole, regardless of which of its processes performs an action; (3) the comparison of two runs becomes a comparison of their resources and of their counts, and each difference points to a particular resource, e.g., a file that only one of the two runs reads.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用这种表示法而非进程树，原因有三。 （1）在每次运行中，资源都会保留其名称，因此两次运行的资源节点可以相互比较；而在进程树中，每个节点都是一个具有唯一 ID 的进程，该 ID 在不同运行之间会发生变化；（2）我们关注的是智能体作为一个整体的行为，而不管其哪个进程执行了具体操作；（3）两次运行的比较转化为对其资源和资源计数的比较，而每种差异都能指向某个特定的资源，例如只有其中一次运行读取的文件。

paragraphs.en: Figure 2 shows the star graph of the citation-check run of Table 1 , restricted to the seven steps in the table. From the graph, we see that the agent runs cat , rg , and sed to read the skill and the bibliography (Rows 1–3). It contacts Crossref (Row 4), Bing and DuckDuckGo (Row 5), runs the Google Scholar script that comes with the skill (Row 6), and writes answer.json (Row 7). Reading the graph does not require interpreting the content of the trajectory: its nodes are the system primitives, i.e., commands executed, files accessed, and hosts contacted. Categorizing the actions therefore needs neither manual labeling nor an LLM-as-a-judge, and the same log entries always result in the same graph, making the analysis deterministic.
paragraphs.zh: 图2展示了表1中引用检查运行的星形图，并限定于表中的七个步骤。 从该图中可以看出，智能体运行了 cat、rg 和 sed 命令来读取技能文件和参考文献（第1–3行）。 它联系了 Crossref（第4行）、Bing 和 DuckDuckGo（第5行），运行了随技能附带的 Google Scholar 脚本（第6行），并生成了 answer.json 文件（第7行）。 阅读该图无需解释轨迹的内容：其节点是系统原语，即执行的命令、访问的文件和联系的主机。 因此，对操作进行分类既不需要人工标注，也不需要 LLM 作为裁判，并且相同的日志条目总会生成相同的图，使得分析具有确定性。

paragraphs.en: The similarity metric measures how consistent the agent is, in terms of its actions, across different runs. A low similarity shows that the agent approaches the task in very different ways; this may indicate that there are multiple ways to solve the same task, that the task is not well-defined, or that the agent deviates substantially from the task’s intent. We reduce each run to the three resource types in the graph, i.e., its commands, its file accesses, and its hosts, and each resource, e.g., reads:/root/test.bib , to the count on its edge over the whole run. We then divide each count by the sum of the counts of the corresponding resource type, which gives the proportion of the resource in the run. The similarity thus compares which actions the agent performs in a certain run with their proportions, rather than considering the absolute number of actions: for instance, if the agent contacts Crossref 10 times and OpenAlex 2 times in run a a , and contacts Crossref 20 times and OpenAlex 4 times in run b b , the two runs have the same proportions for the hosts (5/6 for Crossref and 1/6 for OpenAlex), and thus a similarity of 1. More formally, for two runs a a and b b and one resource type T T , the similarity is the weighted Jaccard index of the proportions: 𝑠𝑖𝑚 T ​ ( a , b ) = ∑ r min ⁡ ( p a ​ ( r ) , p b ​ ( r ) ) / ∑ r max ⁡ ( p a ​ ( r ) , p b ​ ( r ) ) \mathit{sim}_{T}(a,b)=\sum_{r}\min(p_{a}(r),p_{b}(r))/\sum_{r}\max(p_{a}(r),p_{b}(r)) , where r r ranges over the resources of T T in both runs, and p a ​ ( r ) p_{a}(r) is the proportion of r r in a a , or 0 if a a does not have r r . The similarity is 1 when the two runs have the same resources in the same proportions, and 0 when they have no resource in common. The similarity of two runs is the average similarity over the three resource types, and the similarity of a set of runs is the average similarity over all of its pairs.
paragraphs.zh: 相似性指标衡量智能体在不同运行中其行为的一致性程度。 较低的相似性表明智能体以截然不同的方式处理任务；这可能意味着同一任务存在多种解决方式、任务定义不明确，或智能体的行为严重偏离了任务的意图。 我们将每次运行简化为图中的三种资源类型，即其命令、文件访问和主机，并将每种资源（例如 reads:/root/test.bib ）转换为整个运行过程中其边上的计数。 然后，我们将每个计数除以对应资源类型的总计数，从而得到该资源在运行中的比例。 因此，相似性比较的是智能体在特定运行中执行的操作及其比例，而非绝对操作次数：例如，如果智能体在运行 a a 中联系了 Crossref 10 次和 OpenAlex 2 次，而在运行 b b 中联系了 Crossref 20 次和 OpenAlex 4 次，那么两次运行中主机的比例相同（Crossref 为 5/6，OpenAlex 为 1/6），因此相似性为 1。 更正式地，对于两次运行 a a 和 b b 以及一种资源类型 T T ，相似性是比例的加权 Jaccard 指数：𝑠𝑖𝑚 T ​ ( a , b ) = ∑ r min ⁡ ( p a ​ ( r ) , p b ​ ( r ) ) / ∑ r max ⁡ ( p a ​ ( r ) , p b ​ ( r ) ) \mathit{sim}_{T}(a,b)=\sum_{r}\min(p_{a}(r),p_{b}(r))/\sum_{r}\max(p_{a}(r),p_{b}(r)) ，其中 r r 遍历两次运行中 T T 的所有资源，而 p a ​ ( r ) 是 r r 在 a a 中的比例；如果 a a 不包含 r r ，则为 0。 当两次运行具有相同的资源且比例一致时，相似性为 1；当它们没有任何共同资源时，相似性为 0。 两次运行的相似性是三种资源类型相似性的平均值，而一组运行的相似性则是其所有运行对相似性的平均值。

paragraphs.en: The skill coverage metric is relevant in all tasks equipped with skills and measures the fraction of the files of a given skill that the agent reads, writes, or executes. In tasks with multiple skills, AgentSpy reports both the per-skill coverage and the average skill coverage across multiple skills. This metric captures the extent to which the agent uses the guidance from the skills to solve the task. A low skill coverage hints that the agent ignores skills, and approaches the task from first principles .
paragraphs.zh: 技能覆盖度指标适用于所有配备技能的任务，用于衡量智能体对某一特定技能文件中读取、写入或执行操作的比例。 在包含多种技能的任务中，AgentSpy 会报告每种技能的覆盖度以及跨多种技能的平均技能覆盖度。 该指标反映了智能体利用技能提供的指导来完成任务的程度。 较低的技能覆盖度表明智能体忽略了技能，而是从第一性原理出发解决任务。

paragraphs.en: The bottom of the table shows the pairwise similarity and the set similarity per resource type, as well as the set similarity averaged across all resource types (bottom right corner). Runs R1 and R2 are roughly similar across all resource types, with a similarity of at least 0.67. On the other hand, run R3 differs from the others, especially for commands (similarity of 0.36 for both R1–R3 and R2–R3). All three runs pass the nine tests, while the similarity shows that R3, which is the run of Table 1 , is different. After Crossref returns only fuzzy matches, the agent searches Bing and DuckDuckGo through curl , which the skill does not prescribe. These searches fail too, so the agent bases its verdict on the DOI prefixes and on the missing Crossref match. The same agent with the same model thus solves the task in different ways across runs, and the similarity tells the developer which run and which resources to inspect.

paragraphs.en: The table also shows that all runs have a very low skill coverage. paragraphs.en: As a safety analysis, AgentSpy supports a security analysis, which checks prohibitions, i.e., actions that an execution must never perform, against an attacker that can either author a malicious skill or modify an existing one. Indeed, skills are distributed through public marketplaces and can be turned into a third-party supply-chain surface analogous to package registries Liu et al., 2026a . We assume that the host operating system, the agent SDK, and the agent implementation are benign.
paragraphs.zh: 作为一项安全分析，AgentSpy 支持安全性分析，该分析会检查禁止操作，即执行过程绝不允许执行的操作，以应对能够编写恶意技能或修改现有技能的攻击者。 实际上，技能通过公共市场分发，可能成为类似软件包注册表的第三方供应链环节 Liu et al., 2026a 。 我们假设主机操作系统、智能体 SDK 以及智能体实现本身是良性的。

paragraphs.en: AgentSpy defines a set of rules for system calls within the isolated environment where the agent runs. We define four classes of rules: (1) reads of credentials and secrets, (2) modification or deletion of files outside the agent workspace, (3) running programs from untrusted locations and gaining privileges, and (4) network activity to untrusted domains.
paragraphs.zh: AgentSpy 为智能体运行于隔离环境中的系统调用定义了一套规则。 我们将规则分为四类：（1）读取凭证和机密信息，（2）修改或删除智能体工作区之外的文件，（3）从不可信位置运行程序并获取权限，以及（4）与不可信域的网络活动。

sents.en: AgentSpy defines a set of rules for system calls within the isolated environment where the agent runs.
sents.zh: AgentSpy 为智能体运行于隔离环境中的系统调用定义了一套规则。

sents.en: We define four classes of rules: (1) reads of credentials and secrets, (2) modification or deletion of files outside the agent workspace, (3) running programs from untrusted locations and gaining privileges, and (4) network activity to untrusted domains.
sents.zh: 我们将规则分为四类：（1）读取凭证和机密信息，（2）修改或删除智能体工作区之外的文件，（3）从不可信位置运行程序并获取权限，以及（4）与不可信域的网络活动。

paragraphs.en: Each rule tests a single system call, e.g., whether it opens a file in a .ssh directory that is not a public key. Thus, a rule states that the agent never makes such a call, and AgentSpy checks all rules in one pass over the recorded calls. An alert identifies the violated rule and the values needed to judge it, e.g., the name, command line, and working directory of the process that opened a private key. The rules are broadly applicable across tasks as every predicate refers to concepts of the operating system: the agent user, the agent workspace, the standard locations of credentials, system and startup files, temporary directories, and system calls that change privileges. Current coding agents draw a similar boundary in their sandboxes, which in their standard configuration 1 1 1 codex by default and Claude Code in manual mode. permit writes inside the workspace, and restrict writes outside it as well as network access 1, 1 ; 4, 4 , indicating that benign coding tasks are expected to stay within it. When a task legitimately needs a resource outside the boundary, such as a package registry, the allow list of the corresponding class is extended for that task, without requiring a rule change.
paragraphs.zh: 每条规则都测试单个系统调用，例如，判断该调用是否在一个非公钥的 .ssh 目录中打开文件。 因此，一条规则规定智能体绝不允许执行此类调用，而 AgentSpy 会在一次遍历记录的所有调用的过程中检查所有规则。 警报会指出被违反的规则以及判断该规则所需的值，例如，打开私钥的进程的名称、命令行和工作目录。 这些规则广泛适用于各种任务，因为每个谓词都引用了操作系统的概念：智能体用户、智能体工作区、凭证的标准位置、系统和启动文件、临时目录以及改变权限的系统调用。 当前的编码智能体在其沙盒中划定了类似的边界，在标准配置下，Codex 默认允许在工作区内写入，而 Claude Code 在手动模式下则限制工作区外的写入和网络访问，这表明良性编码任务预计会保持在边界内。 当任务确实需要边界之外的资源（例如软件包注册表）时，只需为相应类别的允许列表添加例外即可满足该任务需求，而无需修改规则。

paragraphs.en: Coding agent sandboxes are complementary to the security analysis AgentSpy offers: a sandbox protects the user when running an agent, while AgentSpy assesses the behavior of the agent that uses a certain skill to solve a task (e.g., to audit the skill and decide whether to use it in production). When the agent uses a compromised skill, its sandbox blocks an action that crosses the boundary and reports the violation to the agent, so the blocked action, and every step that depends on it, never execute. On the other hand, AgentSpy lets the agent use the compromised skill within an isolated environment, and applies its rules at the system level, independently of the agent, so the attack runs to completion and each step that matches a rule raises an alert.
paragraphs.zh: 编码智能体的沙箱与 AgentSpy 提供的安全分析功能互为补充：沙箱在运行智能体时保护用户，而 AgentSpy 则评估使用特定技能完成任务的智能体的行为（例如，审核该技能并决定是否在生产环境中使用它）。 当智能体使用被入侵的技能时，其沙箱会阻止跨越边界的操作，并向智能体报告违规行为，因此被阻止的操作以及所有依赖该操作的步骤都不会执行。 另一方面，AgentSpy 允许智能体在隔离环境中使用被入侵的技能，并在系统层面独立于智能体应用其规则，这样攻击就能完整执行，且每个匹配到规则的步骤都会触发警报。

paragraphs.en: AgentSpy is implemented in Go, and the analysis runner is a separate Python package that reads only the collected run artifacts, so the analyses can be repeated or replaced without running the agent again. Each isolated environment is a Firecracker Services, 2026 microVM booted from an Ubuntu root filesystem that is built once per execution kind and reused unchanged, so every run starts from the same state. We use codex CLI 0.146.0 as the agent (non-interactively) with plugins disabled.

paragraphs.en: For the reliability analysis, AgentSpy records system calls with the Linux audit subsystem ( auditd ), under a rule set restricted to the agent user and its process tree. The laurel threathunters-io, 2026 plugin converts the audit stream into JSON with resolved execve arguments, and Zeek 5, 5 logs the network traffic, from which AgentSpy maps the addresses in the audit log to the host names of the star graph. For the security analysis, AgentSpy runs only Falco 3, 3 0.44.1, on the modern_ebpf driver, and a kernel built with BTF and kprobe support, with the rule set of Section 3.5 in place of the default rules.
paragraphs.zh: 在可靠性分析中，AgentSpy 使用 Linux 审计子系统（auditd）记录系统调用，其规则集仅限于智能体用户及其进程树。 laurel threathunters-io, 2026 插件将审计流转换为包含已解析 execve 参数的 JSON 数据，而 Zeek 5, 5 则记录网络流量，AgentSpy 据此将审计日志中的地址映射到星形图中的主机名。 在安全性分析中，AgentSpy 仅在 modern_ebpf 驱动上运行 Falco 3, 3 0.44.1，并使用包含 BTF 和 kprobe 支持的内核，同时以第 3.5 节的规则集替代默认规则。

paragraphs.en: To evaluate whether the reliability analysis of AgentSpy captures the behavior of an agent, we compare executions that are expected to behave similarly with executions that are expected to behave differently. Since there is no ground truth for behavioral similarity, we use the task as a proxy: executions of the same task should be more similar to each other than to executions of a different task. We use the SkillsBench Li et al., 2026b benchmark, which provides 87 tasks across 8 domains, including software engineering, mathematics, cybersecurity, and content production. These tasks have three levels of difficulty, easy (6), medium (53) and hard (28). paragraphs.en: We evaluate three recent models, all released between July and August 2026, shortly before our experiments (i.e., August–September 2026): one proprietary model and two open-weight models from three different providers. As the proprietary model, we selected gpt-5.6-terra (OpenAI, July 2026), the mid-tier of the 5.6 family, which balances cost and performance between the flagship Sol and the low-cost Luna tiers. As open-weight models, we selected deepseek-v4-flash (DeepSeek, July 2026) and glm-5.3-flash (Z.ai, August 2026), two fast Mixture-of-Experts models that their providers optimize for coding and agentic tool use. We executed all three models under the same agent harness (i.e., codex ), so differences in behavior reflect the model and not the harness. 2 2 2 Overall, the reliability analysis consumed around 2 B tokens, and the agent executions lasted a total time of 65 hours. When codex is used with gpt-5.6-terra , the agent runtime is the shortest, with a median of 103 seconds per task, while it is the longest with glm-5.3-flash , with a median of 413 seconds per task.

paragraphs.en: To assess whether the reliability analysis can distinguish executions with different behavior, we compare the executions of each task x x with the executions of the task x ′ x^{\prime} that is most dissimilar to x x . Dissimilarity is defined over the skills: among the tasks executed with the same model, x ′ x^{\prime} is the one whose merged SKILL.md documentation has the largest cosine distance from that of x x , computed on all-MiniLM-L6-v2 embeddings. Since the two tasks require different skills, we expect their executions to behave differently. We then build sets of three executions in which k k executions come from x ′ x^{\prime} and the remaining 3 − k 3-k from x x , for k = 0 , 1 , 2 k=0,1,2 . At k = 0 k=0 , the set is homogeneous , i.e., it consists of the three executions of x x . At k = 1 k=1 and k = 2 k=2 , the set is mixed , and there are 9 ways to choose its executions. For each combination we compute the similarity metric of the set of executions defined in Section 3.4.2 , and for each task and each k k we report the average set similarity across these combinations, both when considering all resource types, and when considering each one individually.

paragraphs.en: 4a shows the set similarities on gpt-5.6-terra . For each of the 77 tasks, we report the set similarity for homogeneous sets of executions, and for mixed ones. We observe that homogeneous sets are typically more similar than mixed sets, with the average set similarity being 0.60 in the homogeneous case, and 0.30 for mixed sets on average. Given a point in the homogeneous set and one in either of the two mixed sets, the former has a higher set similarity in 93.5% of the cases. Similar results hold for deepseek-v4-flash and glm-5.3-flash , and counting all the three models, they have higher similarity in 92.2% of the cases. paragraphs.en: To measure the impact of each resource type, we repeat the analysis with each resource type in isolation. 4b shows the separation margin of each task, when considering all resource types and each resource type in isolation. The separation margin of a task is the difference between the similarity of the homogeneous set and the maximum of the similarities of the two mixed sets, which makes the margin a conservative measure, since the homogeneous set is compared with the most similar mixed set. A positive margin means that the runs of the task are more alike than runs mixed with those of another task, and the higher the margin, the higher the discrimination power of a resource type (or of their combination). A margin of zero or below means that the resource type does not discriminate homogeneous runs of a task.

paragraphs.en: For RQ2, we use the same setup of RQ1 except that, for each model, we keep only the tasks for which all three runs pass all test cases. Indeed, whether the task is solved reliably can be assessed by the test pass rate; however, analyzing how it is solved is the objective of AgentSpy’s reliability analysis. In particular, codex with gpt-5.6-terra solved 40 tasks correctly, with deepseek-v4-flash 27, and with glm-5.3-flash 21, for a total of 88 task–model pairs and 264 reports. Two authors (i.e., assessors) independently inspected AgentSpy’s report for every task and model. paragraphs.en: When characterizing unrelated activities, the two assessors identified three clusters: environment exploration , i.e., the agent started exploring the execution environment; unrequested network access , i.e., the agent consulted a service that is irrelevant to the task; and test file access , i.e., the agent read the test cases that are used to grade the task. The largest cluster across models is unrequested network access (8 tasks). An example of this behavior is under glm-5.3-flash solving the citation-check task (i.e., see Table 2 ); in the third run, the agent conducted a web search on duckduckgo , even though this was not specified by the task. In 5 tasks, the agent started exploring the execution environment, e.g., the directories around its workspace. In 6 tasks, all under deepseek-v4-flash , the agent read the benchmark’s own test files; e.g., in one of the runs of sec-financial-report , the agent read the test cases before writing the solution.
paragraphs.zh: 在描述无关活动时，两位评估者识别出三个聚类：环境探索，即智能体开始探索执行环境；未请求的网络访问，即智能体咨询了与任务无关的服务；以及测试文件访问，即智能体读取了用于评分的测试用例。 各模型中最大的聚类是未请求的网络访问（8 个任务）。 这种行为的一个例子是 glm-5.3-flash 在解决引文核查任务时的表现（即参见表 2）；在第三次运行中，智能体在 duckduckgo 上进行了网络搜索，尽管任务并未要求这样做。 在 5 个任务中，智能体开始探索执行环境，例如其工作区周围的目录。 在 6 个任务中（全部使用 deepseek-v4-flash），智能体读取了基准测试本身的测试文件；例如，在 sec-financial-report 的一次运行中，智能体在编写解决方案之前读取了测试用例。

paragraphs.en: While characterizing the answers to the second question, the two assessors identified two clusters: oracle reuse , i.e., the agent reverse engineered the result from the oracle instead of computing it; and skill files ignored , i.e., the agent did not use some or all of the skill files. Most of the flagged tasks belong to this second cluster (14/15), as they have at least one run in which the agent did not consult the skill files in part or in whole. For instance, under gpt-5.6-terra , the agent opened only the SKILL.md file of the citation-management skill in all three runs. This file is one of the 14 files of the skill, and the agent never opened the validation scripts. The agent instead checked the bibliography entries directly against the Crossref API. A similar behavior happens under glm-5.3-flash (see Table 2 ). However, here the agent not only builds a custom solution in the third run, flagged by a low skill coverage, but the custom solution is also flawed. By also consulting the trajectory (see Table 1 ), we notice that the agent only checks the titles of the references against a ground truth (i.e., Crossref), instead of the respective DOIs as prescribed by its skill. Essentially, the agent judges that the three DOIs look suspicious and searches for their titles; Crossref returns only fuzzy matches and the web searches return no titles, hence the agent concludes that the corresponding citations are fabricated. The final result is correct and the tests pass, yet the agent reached it without the domain knowledge embedded in the skill, i.e., that the validity of a reference is established through its DOI, which identifies the reference uniquely.

paragraphs.en: We assess whether the runtime evidence AgentSpy collects supports security analysis, using the Skill-Inject dataset Schmotz et al., 2026 . Skill-Inject is a benchmark that measures the vulnerability of coding agents to attacks delivered through skill files. It comprises 202 injection–task pairs, in which a benign task is combined with a skill that carries a malicious instruction. An injection is either direct , when the malicious action is stated inside SKILL.md , or script , when the instruction directs the agent to run a malicious auxiliary script shipped with the skill. A script injection hides the harmful action from a review of the skill, since SKILL.md only directs the agent to run a script, and the harmful commands appear only in the script itself (which could also be downloaded from the network). This is also the case in which the trajectory is least informative ( Section 2.3 ): it records a single command that runs the script, and none of the files read or deleted, the contacted hosts, or the executed processes, which only a system-level monitor observes. Moreover, Schmotz et al. (2026) report that script injections succeed more often, because the agent usually trusts executable code that is not always checked. Of the eight attacks that Schmotz et al. (2026) define, five are applicable to script injections, and we select one case from each: data exfiltration (S1), data destruction (S2), denial of service (S3), malware (S4), and backdoors (S5).
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用 Schmotz 等人（2026）提出的 Skill-Inject 数据集，评估 AgentSpy 收集的运行时证据是否支持安全性分析。Skill-Inject 是一项基准测试，用于衡量编码智能体在面对通过技能文件发起的攻击时的脆弱性。该数据集包含 202 对注入任务，其中每个任务都由一个良性任务与一个包含恶意指令的技能组合而成。注入方式分为两种：直接注入（当恶意行为明确写在 SKILL.md 中时）和脚本注入（当指令要求智能体运行随技能附带的恶意辅助脚本时）。在脚本注入的情况下，有害行为在审查技能文件时不会被发现，因为 SKILL.md 仅指示智能体运行一个脚本，而有害命令则只出现在脚本本身中（该脚本也可能从网络下载）。这种情况也是轨迹信息量最少的情况（第 2.3 节）：轨迹仅记录运行脚本的单个命令，而并未记录所读取或删除的文件、所接触的主机或所执行的过程——这些内容只有系统级监控器才能观察到。此外，Schmotz 等人（2026）指出，脚本注入的成功率更高，因为智能体通常会信任那些未经充分检查的可执行代码。在 Schmotz 等人（2026）定义的八种攻击中，有五种适用于脚本注入，我们从中各选取一种案例：数据外泄（S1）、数据销毁（S2）、拒绝服务（S3）、恶意软件（S4）和后门（S5）。

paragraphs.en: We run every task in an injected and a control condition. In the injected condition, the SKILL.md carries the instruction that directs the agent to the malicious script. In each scenario, the benchmark writes a specific file once the malicious script is executed, which signals whether the agent carried out the injected behavior. AgentSpy observes system calls during the execution and applies the deterministic rules of Section 3.5 . Reads and writes inside the workspace are permitted by design, and connections to the model provider ( openrouter.ai ) are in the allow list, so that ordinary task activity raises no alert. We run each task five times per condition (50 runs in total) and manually inspect (a) whether the agent carried out the injected behavior and (b) whether AgentSpy detected it.

Since adding a remote is harmful only for some tasks, detecting it requires a custom rule, e.g., to flag any new remote in a task that has no reason to add one.

paragraphs.en: In RQ4, we measure how much AgentSpy’s monitoring tools (i.e., auditd , laurel , and Zeek for the reliability analysis and Falco for the security analysis) slow down a task execution. Regarding the reliability analysis, for each of the three models of Section 4.1 , we ranked its tasks by the mean duration of their passing runs and selected the fastest task, the slowest task, and the task in the middle of the ranking, which we call the average task. Similarly, for the security analysis, we selected the fastest (category S3), slowest (category S4) and average (category S1) task, where an injection is successful. We executed each selected task ten times with the monitoring tools and ten times without them, for a total of 180 + 60 runs. For each run, we time the main command that runs the agent, excluding the provisioning of the task, and the hooks that start the observation before the run, and collect the evidence after it. The runs of the two conditions are independent, so we compare them per task with a two-sided Mann-Whitney U test Arcuri & Briand, 2014 using α = 0.05 \alpha=0.05 as the threshold for statistical significance. The experiments consumed 730 M tokens and 20 hours of agent runtime.
paragraphs.zh: 在 RQ4 中，我们测量了 AgentSpy 的监控工具（即用于可靠性分析的 auditd、laurel 和 Zeek，以及用于安全性分析的 Falco）在多大程度上会减缓任务执行速度。 关于可靠性分析，对于第 4.1 节中的每个模型，我们都根据其成功运行次数的平均持续时间对任务进行排序，并选择了最快的任务、最慢的任务以及排名中间的任务，我们将其称为平均任务。 同样地，在安全性分析中，我们选择了最快的（S3 类别）、最慢的（S4 类别）和平均的（S1 类别）任务，这些任务中注入操作是成功的。 我们对每个选定的任务分别进行了十次带监控工具的运行和十次不带监控工具的运行，总共进行了 180 + 60 次运行。 对于每次运行，我们计时执行智能体的主命令（不包括任务的准备过程），以及运行前启动观察的钩子和运行后收集证据的钩子。 两种条件下的运行是独立的，因此我们对每个任务使用双侧曼-惠特尼 U 检验（Arcuri & Briand, 2014）进行比较，并以 α = 0.05 作为统计显著性的阈值。 这些实验消耗了 730 M 个 token 和 20 小时的智能体运行时间。

paragraphs.en: Table 4 shows the median execution time, in seconds, when the agent is executed with and without monitoring tools enabled. We compare the two conditions per model and per task, since a comparison between models is not meaningful when the tasks are different. In 8 of the 12 comparisons the median is lower with the monitoring tools, which is unlikely to be an effect of the tools, because they use extra CPU and disk and cannot speed up the agent, so these differences come from the variation between runs. The standard deviation explains this: over the ten runs of each condition, it ranges from 7% to 85% of the median, for both the reliability and the security analysis. Accordingly, the p p -value of each comparison (Column p p -value of Table 4 ) is higher than α \alpha in all cases, so we find no significant difference between the two conditions. The Cohen’s effect size Cohen, 1992 (Column d d ) is small in 8 comparisons and medium in 4, and it is never large. With ten runs per condition, the test is sensitive only to large effects, and a power analysis with α = 0.05 \alpha=0.05 and a power of 0.8 0.8 shows that detecting the observed effects would require from 30 to 18,200 runs per condition. Therefore, any overhead of AgentSpy is small compared with the variation between runs of the same agent on the same task, and in practice it is unlikely to affect an agent execution.

paragraphs.en: Ou et al. (2025) introduce AgentDiagnose , an approach that couples an LLM-based evaluator with a visualization dashboard, so that users can inspect the internal states and decisions an agent reports. Liu et al. (2026) propose AgentDoG , a diagnostic guardrail that monitors trajectories and diagnoses the root cause of unsafe actions with a supervised fine-tuned model. Liu et al. (2025) propose TraceAegis , which derives a hierarchical representation of an agent’s tool invocations and profiles its behavior to detect violations, and Advani (2026) train a siamese recurrent autoencoder for online anomaly detection over trajectories. For coding agents, Li et al. (2026a) reconstruct an execution as a hierarchical trace tree, and localize the failure onset, i.e., the earliest critical step and the downstream chain it triggers, on step-level annotated trajectories from four frameworks. Su et al. (2026) treat instruction following as a constraint-satisfaction problem and return a verdict per constraint. Their results depend on the agent’s cooperation and completeness, and their granularity is a single action ( Section 2 ). In contrast, AgentSpy observes executions outside the agent process ( Section 3 ), capturing actions of helper scripts that trajectories may omit, whether intended or accidental. It therefore complements the agent’s reasoning.
paragraphs.zh: Ou 等人 （2025）提出了 AgentDiagnose，这是一种将基于大语言模型的评估器与可视化仪表板相结合的方法，使用户能够检查智能体所报告的内部状态和决策。Liu 等人 （2026）提出了 AgentDoG，一种诊断性防护机制，它通过监督微调模型监控轨迹并诊断不安全行为的根本原因。Liu 等人 （2025）提出了 TraceAegis，该方法可推导出智能体工具调用的层次化表示，并通过分析其行为来检测违规行为；而 Advani（2026）则训练了一种孪生循环自编码器，用于对轨迹进行在线异常检测。 对于编码智能体，Li 等人 （2026a）将执行过程重构为层次化轨迹树，并在来自四个框架的带步骤级注释的轨迹上定位故障起始点，即最早的关键步骤及其触发的下游链。Su 等人 （2026）将指令遵循视为一个约束满足问题，并为每个约束返回一个判定结果。 他们的结果取决于智能体的配合程度和信息的完整性，且其粒度仅为单个动作（第 2 节）。 相比之下，AgentSpy 在智能体进程之外观察执行过程（第 3 节），从而捕捉到轨迹中可能被遗漏的辅助脚本的动作，无论这些动作是有意还是偶然。 因此，它能够对智能体的推理过程形成补充。

paragraphs.en: AgentSight Zheng et al., 2025 uses LLMs to understand kernel-level effects of individual executions, while Li et al. (2026) represent capabilities and runtime state as queryable attributed graphs. Other work compares tool calls against references, often ignoring reads because they leave system state unchanged Andrews et al., 2025 . Log analysis and provenance research reduce low-level evidence to comparable units, through template extraction He et al., 2017 , log-based anomaly detection Du et al., 2017 , and attack investigation over audit logs and whole-system provenance Pei et al., 2016 ; Alsaheel et al., 2021 ; Ding et al., 2023 ; Cheng et al., 2024 . AgentSpy, instead, deterministically captures system activities, without an LLM in the loop, to compare repeated executions and quantify their similarity ( Section 3.4 ). Unlike Gaia2 Andrews et al., 2025 , it treats reads as behavior: reading ~/.ssh does not change the state, but can still violate a prohibition. It also compares an agent execution against its assigned skill, exposing executions that succeed without using the domain knowledge developers provided.

paragraphs.en: Existing approaches analyze skills before execution through static analysis and formal guarantees Hou & Yang, 2026 ; Paz et al., 2026 ; Shaikh, 2026 ; Bhardwaj, 2026 , dynamic sandboxing and taint tracking Ji et al., 2026 , or runtime auditing Lan & Xiao, 2026 . Other approaches enforce policies before an agent action executes. Bühler et al. (2026) restrict what an MCP server can access with a declarative manifest of capabilities, which an enforcement engine applies at runtime. Zheng et al. (2026) let the agent declare policies, such as running the tests before a commit, and enforce them in the operating system kernel, returning feedback that the agent can understand. Mou et al. (2026) use a guardrail model that reads the interaction history and flags an unsafe tool call before it executes, and Lin et al. (2026) defend against injections in tool calls, i.e., in the metadata and feedback that tools return, by verifying an action against the original intent of the task before the agent commits to it. Gosmar & Dahl (2025) place a network of sentinel agents in a multi-agent system to monitor the communication between agents and flag threats. Dynamic analyzers such as Ji et al. (2026) audit a skill before it is installed by running it with an agent in a sandbox, where reads of sensitive files return placeholder markers that the analyzer tracks through the agent context, processes, and network calls. In contrast, the security analysis of AgentSpy takes a task as input, runs the agent in a microVM with a full operating system, and applies rules over system calls to any agent execution, which do not refer to a skill.

(2026) 通过一个声明式的能力清单限制 MCP 服务器可访问的内容，并由执行引擎在运行时应用该清单。Zheng et al. (2026) 允许智能体声明策略（例如在提交代码前运行测试），并在操作系统内核中强制执行这些策略，返回智能体能够理解的反馈。Mou et al. (2026) 使用一种护栏模型，该模型会读取交互历史，并在不安全的工具调用执行前将其标记出来。Lin et al. (2026) 通过在执行前验证动作是否符合任务的原始意图，来防御工具调用中的注入攻击，即防御工具返回的元数据和反馈中的注入攻击。 Gosmar & Dahl (2025) 在多智能体系统中部署一个由哨兵智能体组成的网络，以监控智能体之间的通信并标记潜在威胁。 动态分析器（如 Ji et al. sents.en: In contrast, the security analysis of AgentSpy takes a task as input, runs the agent in a microVM with a full operating system, and applies rules over system calls to any agent execution, which do not refer to a skill.
sents.zh: 相比之下，AgentSpy 的安全分析以任务为输入，在包含完整操作系统的微虚拟机中运行智能体，并对任何智能体执行过程中的系统调用应用规则，而这些规则并不直接引用具体技能。

paragraphs.en: The behavior of AI agents is difficult to understand and the trajectory of an AI agent records only what the agent reports about itself, one action at a time. We presented AgentSpy, which runs the agent in an isolated environment and records its behavior, including the system calls and network traffic of every process it spawns. Two families of analyses build on it: (1) conformance analyses measure what an execution should do, (2) safety analyses check what it must never do. Our experiments demonstrate that our approach is effective, and adds no significant overhead. For (1) we design a reliability analysis, which summarizes each execution as a star graph of commands, files, and hosts; it tells executions of different tasks apart in 92.2 % 92.2\% of the comparisons and, among executions that pass all tests, reveals unrelated activities ( 18 % 18\% of the cases), reads of the grading files ( 7 % 7\% ), and results reached without the skill’s guidance ( 17 % 17\% ). For (2) we propose a security analysis that flags four of the five attack categories without false alerts.
paragraphs.zh: AI 智能体的行为难以理解，而 AI 智能体的轨迹仅记录该智能体每次报告自身状态的信息。 我们提出了 AgentSpy，它能在隔离环境中运行智能体，并记录其行为，包括其启动的每个进程的系统调用和网络流量。 有两类分析方法基于此构建：（1）合规性分析衡量执行过程应完成的任务；（2）安全性分析检查其绝不允许执行的操作。 我们的实验表明，该方法有效且不会带来显著的性能开销。 针对（1），我们设计了一种可靠性分析，将每次执行总结为包含命令、文件和主机的星形图；在 92.2% 的比较中，该分析能够区分不同任务的执行过程，并且在通过所有测试的执行过程中，揭示了无关活动（18% 的情况）、对评分文件的读取（7%）以及在没有技能指导的情况下达到的结果（17%）。 针对（2），我们提出了一种安全性分析，能够在不产生误报的情况下标记出五种攻击类别中的四种。
